actions.label: Shopping list
actions.description: See what's on your shopping list.
actions.agent: Read the person's shopping list: each item's id, name, quantity, unit and whether it is checked.
actions.when: Pick this to see what is on the person's list, and to find an item's id before you remove it.

errors.means: The person has no shopping list yet.
errors.fix: Add an item with add_shopping_list_item, which starts the list.

show.label: Show
show.description: Which items to list; all of them when left out.

store.label: Store
store.description: Only the items for this store, by its name; every store when left out.

actions.label: Add to list
actions.description: Add an item to your shopping list.
actions.agent: Add one item to the person's shopping list. Give the name as the person said it; leave quantity and unit out when they gave none.
actions.when: Pick this to put one new thing the person asked for on their list; to take one off, use remove_shopping_list_item.

errors.means: The item's name is over 200 characters.
errors.fix: Send the item's name alone, and put any detail in quantity and unit.

name.label: Item
name.description: What to buy, as the person said it, such as "oat milk".
name.ask: What should I add to your list?

unit.label: Unit
unit.description: The unit of the quantity, such as g, cups or cans.

idempotencyKey.label: Idempotency key
idempotencyKey.description: Send the same key again when retrying this exact call, and the item is added once.

actions.label: Remove
actions.description: Take an item off your shopping list.
actions.agent: Remove one item from the person's shopping list by its id. Removing an item that is already gone changes nothing.
actions.when: Pick this to take an item off the list once get_shopping_list has given you its id.

alsoIds.label: Other items
alsoIds.description: More item ids to remove in the same call.

actions.label: Share list
actions.description: Share your shopping list with someone in your household.
actions.agent: Share the person's shopping list with another person, who can then see and change it.
actions.when: Pick this only when the person asked to share their list with someone by email.

errors.means: No one in the person's household has that email address.
errors.fix: Ask the person for the email address of someone in their household.

actions.confirm: Share your list with this person? They will be able to see it and change it.

with.label: With
with.description: The email address of the person to share with.

canEdit.label: Can edit
canEdit.description: Whether they may change the list, not only see it.

message.label: Note
message.description: A note to send with the invitation.

actions.label: Place order
actions.description: Order everything on your list and pay for it.
actions.agent: Order the shopping list's items for delivery and pay for them.

personOnly.reason: You can't place an order or pay for the person; only they can.
personOnly.how: with Place order on the shopping list
